ideas.pitch: An AI agent platform integrated with campus workflows that screens for early-stage depression and academic burnout using voice biomarkers and conversational journaling, automatically routing severe cases to institutional medical boards with privacy-first encryption.
ideas.title: AuraCare: AI-Powered Preventive Mental Health & Diagnostic Triage for Campuses
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Healthcare and Well being track's focus on mental health and hospital workflows, solving a massive administrative and student welfare problem for the engineering college organizers.

ideas.pitch: A spatial tracking and matching platform that connects manufacturing plants with recycling startups to trade industrial byproducts and scrap materials, optimizing local supply chains for zero-waste compliance.
ideas.title: CircuGrid: Circular Economy Marketplace & Waste-to-Resource Matchmaker for Industrial Zones
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits squarely into the Sustainability and ClimateTech track by tackling circular economy and waste management with actionable business utility for local industries.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent academic curriculum adjustment platform that scans live job market skill gaps using RAG and automatically generates project-based lab modules and automated assessment rubrics for university departments.
ideas.title: SkillForge: Multi-Agent AI Curriculum Generator for Engineering Institutions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Education Technology track's focus on AI-powered learning, skill development, and campus solutions, making it instantly appealing to academic judges from Fr. Conceicao Rodrigues College of Engineering.

ideas.pitch: A real-time irrigation monitoring dashboard combining satellite soil moisture data with local weather forecasting to generate automated, ultra-precise water allocation schedules for regional farmers.
ideas.title: AgriPulse AI: IoT and Satellite-Driven Water Conservation Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages technical difficulty in geospatial data processing while serving the Sustainability and ClimateTech track's specific focus on water conservation and smart agriculture.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web-based diagnostic assistant that analyzes rapid test strip images and basic clinical inputs under low-bandwidth constraints to flag infectious anomalies for community health workers.
ideas.title: BioScan: Computer Vision-Based Point-of-Care Diagnostic Screener for Rural Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Healthcare and Well being track's AI diagnostics and medical devices criteria with a practical deployment angle suited for incubation and real-world pilot tests.
